manualLogReview.method: Read the decoded body returned by the dedicated GitHub job-log action. No exhaustive automatic log scan is claimed.
observations: Checkout and Git Basic authentication values were masked in the reviewed bodies.

artifactInspection.method: Download actual artifact ZIPs, compare SHA-256 with GitHub digest, enumerate every ZIP entry, read and parse all TRX text in memory without executing it.
